source: EASA ATPL 091 VFR Communication ve JAA örnek havuzundaki konulardan, bankada olmayanlar seçilip kendi ifademizle yazıldı. Gerçek sınav metni değildir; kaynak sitenin koşulları metnin kamuya açık kopyalanmasını yasaklıyor. Cevaplar ICAO Annex 10 Vol II, Doc 9432 ve Doc 4444'e göre.
id_convention: 91101+ bandı: 090 ek sorular (090-X). 90901–90996 emekli, yeniden kullanılmaz; 91001–91030 ders notundan üretilmiş (090-U).
selection: Kullanıcının verdiği ~110 soruluk listeden 30'u: 24'ü EASA listesinden, 6'sı JAA listesinden (BREAK, I SAY AGAIN, REPORT, urgency tanımı, parça mesajı = flight regularity, INFORMATION ekı) — JAA'dan yalnız ICAO tanımıyla birebir doğrulananlar. Bankada zaten olanlar, düşük değerliler (RVR açılımı, MHz = 1.000.000 Hz) ve bankayla çelişen JAA DISREGARD sorusu alınmadı.

questions.text: In radiotelephony, what is a "broadcast"?
options: A transmission of information relating to air navigation that is not addressed to a specific station
A transmission made when two-way communication cannot be established but the called station is believed to be receiving
A message addressed to one station that must be read back
A call to all stations that each station must acknowledge in turn

questions.text: What does the abbreviation "AFIS" stand for?
Which Q code gives the true heading to steer, with zero wind, to reach a direction-finding station?
Which list shows message categories in the correct order of priority, highest first?
Where do meteorological messages rank in the order of priority?
options: Below flight safety messages and above flight regularity messages

questions.text: A pilot tells the area control centre: "Request radar vectors to avoid adverse weather." Which message category is this?
A message about aircraft parts and materials that are urgently required belongs to which category?
How many times should a blind transmission be sent?
When transmitting blind because of receiver failure, what else should the pilot include?
options: The time of the next intended transmission
The remaining fuel endurance in minutes
A request for the controller to acknowledge by radio

questions.text: ATC asks you to "Report flight conditions". Which reply is correct?
What does "BREAK BREAK" indicate?
options: Separation between messages to different aircraft in a very busy environment
Separation between portions of one message
The end of the transmission, no reply expected
That the frequency must be vacated immediately

questions.text: Which word separates portions of a message when there is no clear distinction between the text and the other portions?
What does the word "CANCEL" mean?
options: Consider that transmission as not sent
An error has been made; the correct version follows
Your flight plan has been deleted

questions.text: What does "CHECK" mean when used by ATC?
options: Examine a system or procedure; no answer is normally expected
Confirm that you have received and understood the last message

questions.text: Which word is used to mean "permission not granted"?
What does the instruction "MONITOR (frequency)" mean?
options: Establish two-way contact on that frequency
Make a radio check on that frequency
Transmit your position report on that frequency

questions.text: What does "CONFIRM" mean?
options: I request verification of: (clearance, instruction, action, information)
Check and confirm with the originator
I have received all of your last transmission

questions.text: What is the call sign suffix of a radar station in general?
What is the call sign suffix of the approach control radar unit handling departing traffic?
What is the call sign suffix of a station providing flight information service?
An aircraft in the HEAVY wake turbulence category, call sign ANKAIR 512, makes its initial call. How should the call sign be said?
options: "ANKAIR 512"; the word HEAVY is used only on the ground

questions.text: Over flat terrain, up to about what distance can you expect reliable VHF contact with a ground station when flying at FL50?
What is the consequence of a microphone button stuck in the transmit position?
options: The frequency is blocked and other stations cannot use it
Nothing; other stations can still transmit over it
Only the pilot's own receiver is affected

questions.text: What does "Readability 2" mean?
ATC instructs: "Hold short of runway 24." What is the correct acknowledgement?
options: "Holding short (runway 24)" followed by the call sign
"Will stop before the runway" followed by the call sign

questions.text: ATC reports a braking coefficient of 20 (0.20). What braking action does this correspond to?
On which frequency should an urgency message normally be transmitted first?
options: The air-ground frequency in use at the time
The frequency of the nearest radar unit

questions.text: What does "I SAY AGAIN" mean?
options: I repeat for clarity or emphasis
Repeat all, or the following part, of your last transmission
Consider that transmission as not sent

questions.text: Which word means "pass me the following information"?
Which of the following describes an urgency condition?
options: A condition concerning the safety of an aircraft, vehicle or a person on board or within sight, which does not require immediate assistance
A condition of serious and/or imminent danger requiring immediate assistance
Any emergency that occurs while the aircraft is on the ground
Any condition that requires an immediate diversion
